extracted.intended_audience: government or organisational communications professionals (strategic communicators, press officers, internal comms and marketing teams)
extracted.subtask_description: A model describing five communications disciplines (marketing, internal communications, media, external affairs and strategic communications) and how they overlap; intended to guide how communications activity is set, coordinated and delivered to achieve priorities. Useful for organising comms teams and planning integrated communications activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: MCOM model structure (Venn diagram of five disciplines)
rubrics_metrics.description: There are four overlapping circles – marketing, internal communications, media and external affairs – with a fifth circle for ‘strategic communications’ in the middle. These represent the five disciplines of the model.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasises overlap and integration between the four operational disciplines with strategic communications at the centre to coordinate activity across them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic communications
rubrics_metrics.description: sets, co-ordinates and guides the implementation of activity, based on insight as part of an overarching plan to deliver against agreed priorities to measurable effect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Central role: provides the overarching plan, uses insight to set priorities, coordinates activity across disciplines and focuses on measurable outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Marketing
rubrics_metrics.description: raises awareness of policies, influences attitudes and behaviours and supports the operation of services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focuses on audience-facing campaigns and behaviour-change activity that supports service delivery and policy uptake.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internal communications
rubrics_metrics.description: engages staff in delivering priorities and supporting organisational  and cultural change, maximising performance and delivering business strategy most effectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aims to align and mobilise staff behind organisational priorities and cultural change to improve performance and strategy delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media
rubrics_metrics.description: includes proactive and reactive handling of the press relationship management, content creation and insight and evaluation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers press relations (both proactive and reactive), content production and the use of insight and evaluation to inform media activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: External affairs
rubrics_metrics.description: explains policies, but also listens to help build campaigns that deliver.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combines outward explanation of policy with two‑way listening to inform campaign design and stakeholder engagement.
